title: Customer Action Card — Payment Arrangement Installment Schedule Renegotiation
content:
# Customer Action Card — Payment Arrangement Installment Schedule Renegotiation

**Terms.** A customer may ask to change the installment schedule of a Payment Arrangement plan after a change in circumstances. A renegotiation follows the renegotiation rule of the Payment Arrangement program except where these terms set the schedule. Renegotiation is made only on a plan in active status with no installment currently counted as missed, and a plan is renegotiated no more than the number of times its kind allows. The renegotiation is made only on the customer's own acceptance of that schedule.

## Defaulted plans

Where the plan has defaulted, its new regular installment is worked out only after the plan stands in active status again with its reinstatement re-deferral booked back under it as its remaining balance.

## The customer's acceptance — `renegotiate_arrangement_installments_743d0532`

**What the tool records.** The customer's own acceptance of a new installment schedule on one of their payment arrangements. The customer, acting in person, confirms a new total number of installments for the arrangement identified by the reference number (the total counts the installments already billed) and the new regular installment that will be billed for each installment not yet billed; the final installment carries whatever remainder is left. The arrangement's installment count and regular installment amount are replaced by the values confirmed; its status, balance and deferred amount are unchanged. Afterwards a lookup of the arrangement shows the new count and amount.

**How it is invoked.** This is a customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves then runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`, naming `renegotiate_arrangement_installments_743d0532`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `arrangement_id` | The reference number of the customer's payment arrangement whose schedule is being changed, as the representative reads it out from the payment arrangement lookup | Identifier, as shown in the lookup |
| `installment_count` | The new total number of installments of the arrangement, counting those already billed | Whole number (integer), at least 1 |
| `installment_amount` | The new regular installment for each installment not yet billed | US dollars with 2 decimal places, a plain number such as 87.63 with no currency sign; stored rounded half-up to the cent |

**Return.** A text receipt: "Arrangement <arrangement_id> schedule changed: <count> installments in total, regular installment <amount> USD." The count is the new total as an integer and the amount the new regular installment with 2 decimal places. Receiving this receipt means the new schedule is recorded.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

The customer runs the tool with `arrangement_id` ARR-0002, `installment_count` 9 and `installment_amount` 242.48. The receipt reads: "Arrangement ARR-0002 schedule changed: 9 installments in total, regular installment 242.48 USD." The plan's status and the balance held under it are as they were before.
